text.name: Circlet of Wisdom
text.description:
{Circlet of Wizdom}

Increases the hero's knowledge by 3, and regenerates 3 spell points per day
text.event: Sitting in a local tavern, you noticed a learned lady at the next table. You sat down to chat with her and charmed her with your intelligence. But now the time has come to leave. You apologized to her, and she handed you the Circlet of Wisdom. ''If you need a job, you will find me in the Celestean School of Arcane,'' she said finally.
